_doc: Phase 0 bootstrap config (founder self-funded). 30 deposits across 3 denoms = $1,600 USDC. Unblocks Base Sepolia push without waiting for Phase 1's $27,775 treasury/grant. Mix chosen: $10 x 10 + $50 x 10 + $100 x 10 — three distinct denoms give the anonymity-set early diversity at three settlement bands ($10 micro-payment, $50 typical agent call, $100 settlement). Phase 1 (seed-pools.config.json) follows once Base Ecosystem Fund matching capital lands. depositGapMs reduced to 3000 (vs Phase 1's 7500) since only 30 deposits — full run ~90s.

pools.label: USDC (plain 0xbow pool, no yield) - Base Sepolia - Phase 0
